question: What condition is affirmed even for the wise one in relation to nectar and essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence as a means.
Even the wise one, while burning, is under consideration.
inference: Even the wise one, burning with the tip of essence at the tip of nectar, remains under that condition.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation between the compounds remains open from the tokens alone.
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even the wise one burns.
